pr_title: [Doc][Misc] Update num_speculative_tokens to 1 in model tutorials
source_quote: mtp configuration modifications in A2 documentation are missing.

rule.description: 更新模型教程中的 speculative decoding 配置时，应确保所有硬件系列（A2、A3 等）的配置示例都被同步更新，避免遗漏某个系列。
checkpoints: 检查文档中是否存在多个硬件系列的配置段落
确认 `num_speculative_tokens` 等参数在所有系列中一致更新
特别注意 PD disaggregation 场景下 prefill 节点的配置

antipattern.code:
### A2 series

Startup Command:

```bash
    # deepseek-v4-flash-dspark uses the following image
    export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:nightly-main

    docker run --rm \
        --device /dev/davinci0 \
        -v /mnt/share/models:/root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models \
        $IMAGE \
    vllm serve /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/UploadWeight/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-w4a8-test \
        --max-model-len 800000 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
        --speculative-config '{"method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 5, "enforce_eager": true}'
    # ↑ 仅用 enforce_eager，未启用 cudagraph/fullgraph 模式
```

pattern.code:
### A2 series

Startup Command:

```bash
    # deepseek-v4-flash-dspark uses the following image
    export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:nightly-main

    docker run --rm \
        --device /dev/davinci0 \
        -v /mnt/share/models:/root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models \
        $IMAGE \
    vllm serve /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/UploadWeight/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-w4a8-test \
        --max-model-len 800000 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
        --speculative-config '{"method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 7, "enforce_eager": true}'  \
        --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}'
    # ↑ 添加 compilation-config 启用 cudagraph full decode 模式
    # ↑ num_speculative_tokens 也从 5 调整为 7
```
